findings.title: savedNext never set; cleanup clobbers parent's nextResponder
findings.message: On a failed `[session finish:5]` after `panel updateController` (controller mismatch), `cleanup` is invoked, but `vellumOwnsPreview` stays YES even though the panel was possibly created by a foreign owner. Also, if `vellumQuickLook` hits an exception before the observer is set, the parent's nextResponder chain was already modified; the catch only calls finish if the session exists, which is fine, but the `finish:5` path before observer registration leaves `savedNext` unset (never assigned), so cleanup restores `parent.nextResponder=self.savedNext` (nil) and drops the parent's original next responder.
findings.suggestion: Assign session.savedNext=parent.nextResponder when installing the session (it is currently only assigned to session.nextResponder), so cleanup restores the original responder chain.
